title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
blurb: We don't know what Jane Austen really looked like, but we do know what her books looked like: full of typos. Fortunately, those fixed, the contents themselves are quite good.
blurb2: Austen: inventor of free indirect speech and also Darcy. To quote famed Austen-fan Mark Twain out of context: "What [literature] is today, good and bad, it owes to [Jane] … for the bad that [her] colossal invention has brought about is overshadowed a thousand times by the good with which mankind has been favored."
